norfork-tailwater: The cold-water North Fork River below Norfork Dam joins the White River at Norfork, Arkansas. The proposed boat corridor runs from Dam-Quarry Boat Ramp to Norfork Access on the White River just below the confluence. Releases can change conditions along this reach; observed dam readings and generation schedules do not establish a safe wading or departure window. Check the current Arkansas Game and Fish Commission trout regulations for the section you fish.
white: The White River below Bull Shoals Dam is a regulated trout fishery extending downstream through Cotter and Norfork to the Highway 58 bridge at Guion. Bull Shoals releases affect the upper reach; tributaries and Norfork Dam releases also influence water farther downstream. A reading at Bull Shoals does not describe every access point. Check current observations, posted restrictions and Arkansas Game and Fish Commission regulations for your section.
taneycomo: Lake Taneycomo occupies the White River between Table Rock Dam and Powersite Dam. Cold-water releases from Table Rock support its trout fishery and can change the current and water level, especially in the upper reach. The proposed first boat corridor is Shepherd of the Hills Hatchery Boat Ramp to Cooper Creek Access. Dam observations and generation schedules do not establish a safe wading window; check posted restrictions and current Missouri Department of Conservation regulations.
